Name: JP's Shin Dialogue Box
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i][u]Shin Dialogue Box[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]If wood isn't your thing and you don't like seeing things crammed into small spaces, maybe this mod is for you... Or maybe not?[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b]A rework of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8853]original mod[/url], featuring many improvements and Android compatibility.[/b][/size][/font]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Replace the old wooden dialogue boxes with a color gradient.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]A modern touch for the game, with white text that contrasts with the dark background.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Choose between more spaced-out text or text that’s more condensed and centered, just like in the original game.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Choose which side you want the portrait on: the right, as usual, or the left, with new locations for the dialogue boxes.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]You can change the color of the gradient and the text, and you can also customize them for each NPC in the game by assigning a different HEX color to each one.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Mobile-friendly.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Compatible with Shin HD Portraits and Custom Portraits.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=5][b][i][color=#00ff00]That's all for now. Remember to use GMCM to configure everything more easily. [/color][color=#ffff00]On mobile devices, the color-changing options may not be available; you'll need to manually edit the mod's config file. [/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]


[font=Georgia][i][b][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/b][/i]
[size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.[/b]
[b]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [/b][color=#00ffff][b](Recommended)[/b][/color]
[b]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b]


[/size][/font]
